historical_references.reference: The name Vishalraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Vishal' meaning broad and 'Raj' meaning king. This name was used by several Hindu rulers throughout history. One such king was Vishaldev, who ruled over the Rajput kingdom of Jaisalmer in the 12th century.

Another king who bore the name Vishalraj was the founder of the Maratha empire in the early 17th century, Maloji Raje Bhonsle. He was a military leader under the Deccan sultan Adil Shah and later rebelled against him, establishing the Maratha rule in the region.
